response.query: What biobanking SOPs (time-to-freeze tolerances, dissociation times, cryopreservation media) and QC checks will we enforce to limit preanalytic artifact for scRNA and proteomics?
response.answer: Enforce time-to-freeze within 30 minutes, dissociation within 2 hours, and use specialized cryopreservation media. Implement QC checks for cell viability and RNA integrity.
